title: AssetOverlap
description: Alignment of clip B after clip A in a session (spec 8.2.3, M12): whether B's start repeats A's end, where B starts inside A ('offset_ms'), how long the repeat is ('overlap_ms'), with confidence and evidence. 'applied' is what the session timeline uses: a user override, else a 'matched' result of the current algorithm version, else nothing. Low-confidence, ambiguous, stale, or missing results never shorten a clip.

status.description: 'matched': overlap found and confident enough to apply. 'weak': found but below the apply threshold. 'ambiguous': the footage repeats at several offsets (menus, static scenes). 'no_match': no continuous match. 'insufficient': too few usable frames or no fingerprints. 'pending': not computed yet.

current.description: Computed by the current algorithm version. A stale result is never applied.

offset_ms.description: Where B's time 0 falls in A (matched and weak results).

overlap_ms.description: Duration of A's end that B repeats.

evidence.description: What the decision rests on: frame counts, votes per offset, matching frames, longest run, audio correlation, reason. Values are scalars or small arrays.

override.description: The user's overlap for this pair (0 means 'no overlap'). Always applied; recomputation never changes it.

AlignRequest.title: AlignRequest
AlignRequest.description: Params of an 'align' job: the sessions to align (default: all) and whether to recompute current results.

AlignResult.title: AlignResult
AlignResult.description: Result of an 'align' job. Status counts cover computed and cached pairs.

OverlapOverride.title: OverlapOverride
OverlapOverride.description: Set the overlap between a clip and the clip before it (0 = no overlap), or clear the override with null.
